row.description_en: Keep KV Cache Eviction, Token Merging, GQA/MQA and Efficient Architecture Design under their literature names, rather than inventing one universal mechanism family.
row.description_zh: 按原文名称单列 KV Cache Eviction、Token Merging、GQA/MQA 和 Efficient Architecture Design。不把它们统一包装为通用压缩机制。
row.question_zh: 哪些文献专题需要补充关注？

row.description_en: Workload and component labels cross-cut targets and mechanisms.
row.description_zh: 文本、多模态、语音、分布式是场景标签；声码器是语音模型组件。它们不是同一层级的压缩数据对象。

row.description_en: Separate capacity, bandwidth, compute, communication and end-to-end performance; report quality and operating conditions.
row.description_zh: 区分容量、访存、计算、通信与端到端性能；质量、模型、硬件、批量、上下文和训练需求是比较条件。字节减少不自动等于加速。
row.question_zh: 在什么条件下获得什么收益？

row.description_en: Follow TACL 2024 Figure 1: Quantization, Pruning, Knowledge Distillation and Low-Rank Factorization. Methods may compose; do not add overlapping savings.
row.description_zh: 直接沿用 TACL 2024 图 1 的四类方法：量化（Quantization）、剪枝（Pruning）、知识蒸馏（Knowledge Distillation）、低秩分解（Low-Rank Factorization）。组合方法允许多标签，不能重复累计收益。

row.description_en: Use the literature terms Weights, Activations and KV Cache. This object view is research navigation; TACL Figure 1 classifies methods and Table 1 names these three quantization targets.
row.description_zh: 主地图使用文献中的权重（Weights）、激活（Activations）和 KV Cache。该对象视图用于研究导航；TACL 图 1 的一级分类以方法为主，表 1 列出这三种量化对象。
